Same family, added · 2026-11-19T20:20Z · from the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER record on PR #35629 (comment 7021133187, nit N1), read only, not reproduced

The lint's title ladder in `packages/lint/src/validate-semantic-roles.ts` is not the renderer's `resolveNameField`. Where the page's derived title (e.g. `account_name`) is itself listed in `highlightFields`, the lint's cut lands one entry away from the page's, so a group emptied by the seventh entry is not warned. The gap predates PR #35629 (it existed under the 4-cut). Whoever measures this card measures that case too: the lint's hoisted set should be the renderer's, title resolution included.
